caption:
this open-source model is insanely good for how small it is.

MiniCPM5-1B, from Tsinghua’s THUNLP:

> beats every model its size on reasoning, code, & agentic tasks
> 1 checkpoint switches between fast replies and deep reasoning
> drops straight into vllm, sglang, ollama, or llama.cpp, no custom kernels

ships its own agent skills too, Cursor or Claude Code auto-picks the right deploy or fine-tune route instead of you digging through docs.
